objective: Diagnostico aislado READ_ONLY de la consulta SCOPE del Gate3B Custodia. No DDL/DML, no cambios de repositorio, no Produccion.

queries.name: scope
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND ((t.name='Sistema_Empresas' AND c.name='EmpresaID') OR (t.name='Unidades_Negocio' AND c.name='id') OR (t.name='Sistema_Sucursales' AND c.name='SucursalID')) ORDER BY t.name;
